answer: Main campus is at 100 University Way. The Student Services building is open Mon–Fri 8:00–17:00.
Central Library: Mon–Thu 7:00–22:00, Fri 7:00–20:00, Sat–Sun 10:00–18:00. Extended study zones are on Level 3.
Your personal timetable is in the student portal under Academics → Schedule. Contact your department office for room changes.
Exam regulations: arrive 15 minutes early, bring student ID, no phones. Full policy: Student Handbook §8.
Academic integrity and conduct rules are in the Student Handbook. Plagiarism may lead to disciplinary action; use the citation guide from the library website.
Assignments are submitted via the LMS unless your instructor states otherwise. Late penalties follow the course syllabus—ask your professor for extensions.
Tuition deadlines and payment plans are handled by the Bursar’s Office (bursar@university.edu). The chatbot cannot access your account balance.
